findings.detail: scripts/measure-stu.ps1 derives input set from git ls-files --cached sorted Ordinal (L18-32), validates strict UTF-8 (L34,L59-64), computes ceil(bytes/3) exactly per I2.16:2937 fallback formula (L65), emits schema eliot-stu-observation-v1; no timestamps, locale, or environment inputs; executed live: exit=0, observations=544

thresholds 45000/100000 only assign provisional_label (L66-74); every observation carries blocking=false (L80); document status PROVISIONAL_NON_BLOCKING (L86); sole nonzero exits are integrity preconditions: git failure, empty tracked set, invalid UTF-8, missing or root-escaping path (L20-63) - never file size; empirical proof: run passed with 7 files AT_OR_ABOVE_100000 (largest crates/kernel/eliot-installation/src/lib.rs stu=450338) and 15 AT_OR_ABOVE_45000; conforms to I2.16:3017 ('crossing a numeric band alone records profile evidence ... crate is not failed'), :3001, :16688 and to W0-03 disposition rejecting the fail component

ci.yml:57-68 'Workspace topology baseline' parses cargo metadata --locked --format-version 1 --no-deps, throws unless packages==125 and workspace_default_members==6, publishes counts to GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY; fail-closed against silent member drift

ci.yml:87-89 executes pwsh -NoProfile -File scripts/verify.ps1; profile is versioned eliot-verify-v1 declaring 8 steps (metadata, fmt, normative, stu-evidence, workspace-check --locked --workspace --all-targets, workspace-clippy --locked --workspace --all-targets -D warnings, workspace-tests --locked --workspace, cargo-deny check); local Justfile verify/verify-list (Justfile:33-37) alias the same script byte-for-byte; executed verify -List confirms the 8-step identity; NOTE: legacy Justfile quick/metadata/fmt-check/check recipes (Justfile:5-12,31) remain as narrower parallel entry points outside the versioned profile - residual drift surface

ci.yml:70-85 installs with cargo install --locked --version 0.20.2, regex-verifies binary identity '^cargo-deny 0\.20\.2', then records version, resolved path and SHA-256 of the installed binary into GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY - a provenance/digest receipt satisfying I18.21:17527 and I15.9:15158 ('Use cargo deny or equivalent'); NUANCE: the SHA-256 is recorded post-hoc, not compared against a pre-declared expected digest, so a tampered registry artifact would be logged rather than rejected; crates.io registry + Cargo.lock-style locked install mitigates

deny.toml unchanged (licenses allow-list MIT/Apache-2.0/BSD-2-Clause/Unicode-3.0, multiple-versions warn, wildcards deny, unknown registry/git deny) consistent with I15.9:15160-15178 default license policy; no hidden CI-only verifier list remains: previous inline default-members fmt/check/clippy steps were removed in favor of the shared profile

defects.detail: cargo-deny digest is evidence-after-the-fact; I18.21 pinning would be stronger if an expected SHA-256 constant were asserted before execution
legacy Justfile quick target duplicates a stale narrow subset of eliot-verify-v1; future edits to verify.ps1 will silently diverge from quick
stu-evidence prints all 544 observation records to stdout on every CI/local run; log noise grows linearly with repository size; consider summary-only output plus optional full-artifact flag

cargo install cargo-deny compiles from source uncached (~/.cargo/bin not in actions/cache paths, ci.yml:49-55); combined with first full-workspace test run, the 45-minute job timeout (ci.yml:31) is a real cold-cache risk

stu-evidence is blocking on measurement-integrity defects (invalid UTF-8, missing tracked file); correct as a precondition but should stay explicitly distinguished from size semantics in any future profile documentation

disposition.rationale: all five audited checks hold: deterministic measurement, zero size-only failure paths empirically exercised at 7 files above the would-be fail threshold, fail-closed 125/6 topology gate, one versioned shared local/CI verification profile, pinned cargo-deny with recorded digest receipt; implementation matches the safe proposal accepted in the prior W0-03 audit (warn-only evidence, no hard 100k failure)
